jobs.title: Electromechanical Lab Technician supporting Nvidia
jobs.description:
**Sustainable Talent** is partnering with **NVIDIA,** a global leader that has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for over 25 years. We are looking for a **Electromechanical** **Lab Technician** to support our client's lab operations team. This is a **full-time (W-2) contract** role based onsite in **Santa Clara, CA.** We offer competitive pay of **$30/hr - $45/hr** based on factors like experience, education, location, etc., and provide full benefits, PTO, and an amazing company culture!

  

In this role you will build, deploy, and support the hardware systems that engineers rely on every day, from bench-top development platforms to large server racks in the data center. You'll also bring ideas to life by designing and fabricating custom test fixtures and prototype components with CAD and 3D printing. This is an exciting opportunity to work hands-on with some of the most innovative technology in the world and help shape the labs where next-generation robotics and datacenter products are developed. Join us in revolutionizing the world of AI!

  

**What You'll Do:**

* Assemble, build, and install bench-top development platforms and large server systems in the bench lab and rack lab.
* Deploy systems and racks in the data center, connect power and network, and bring them up.
* Support parts replacement projects for small and large volume deployments.
* Prepare boards for detailed solder reworks to be completed by another lab.
* Connect oscilloscope probes to boards and collect signal waveform data.
* Perform mechanical reworks using power tools such as a Dremel.
* Design and produce CAD models and detailed drawings for custom test fixtures, and integrate designs into lab systems.
* Support the development, modification, and refinement of prototype components and fixtures, incorporating feedback from engineers and technicians.
* Use 3D printing and other rapid prototyping methods to fabricate, adjust, and assemble CAD-designed parts.
* Run laboratory tests on prototypes and make modifications to improve functionality and performance.

  

**What We're Looking For:**

* Hands-on experience with 3D CAD tools such as Creo, SolidWorks, OnShape, or Fusion 360 (Creo preferred but not required).
* Experience with prototyping, 3D printing, and manufacturing processes.
* Strong proficiency with hand tools and power tools.
* Familiarity with electrical wiring and basic system integration is a plus.
* Comfort working in a fast-paced, hands-on lab environment alongside cross-functional engineering teams.

  

**About Sustainable Talent**

Sustainable Talent is a certified woman-owned company specializing in recruitment, consulting, and workforce solutions. We partner with innovative organizations to connect exceptional talent with meaningful opportunities across technology, engineering, operations, and professional services.

  

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

Sustainable Talent is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

jobs.title: Robotics Research Assistant
jobs.description:
**Location: San Francisco, California — on-site**

**About Artificial Analysis**
-----------------------------

Artificial Analysis is the leading independent AI benchmarking company. We support labs, engineers, and enterprises to understand AI capabilities and make critical decisions about their AI strategies. We are the go-to authority for understanding AI, from AI labs and enterprises to media, investors, and policymakers. Our benchmarks don’t just measure the cutting edge of AI; they are actively shaping the frontier.

Our benchmarks and analysis are trusted by hundreds of thousands of users and are the go-to reference for leading AI labs including OpenAI, Google, Meta, NVIDIA, and Anthropic, and major publications including the Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg, the Financial Times, and The Economist.

We are a team of 50+, on track to double by year end, backed by Nat Friedman, Daniel Gross, Andrew Ng, Adam D’Angelo, Clem Delangue, and other industry leaders.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

The physical world is where the next generation of AI models will compete. We’re developing our robotics benchmarks to set the industry’s reference point: testing how AI models perform on physical robots and in simulation, and building the analysis that helps the industry understand them.

As a Robotics Research Assistant, you’ll work closely with our robotics researchers and engineers to run benchmarks and keep our robots built, calibrated, tested, and running. You’ll help build and maintain hardware, run our task suite, and set up new simulation environments as we add them.

This is a hands-on lab and benchmark-operations role. It suits a recent graduate or early-career candidate with substantial practical hardware experience who enjoys building, troubleshooting, and carefully running experiments. Expect to spend much of the day setting up, resetting, and monitoring trials.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Build and maintain an evolving suite of hardware.** Power, wire, and health-check hardware so each station is ready to run. Work efficiently to understand unfamiliar hardware and incorporate it into our fleet.
* **Run the task suite and read the results.** Set up task scenes, run startup and shutdown checks, and monitor trials on physical robots and in simulation.
* **Protect result quality.** Check that recordings and logs are complete and linked to the right task, model, and configuration. Record interventions and distinguish model failures from equipment, setup, or simulation faults.
* **Maintain the hardware.** Assemble hardware, route cables, mount fixtures and cameras, calibrate equipment, manage spare parts, and make the small mechanical fixes that keep a fleet running.
* **Keep the lab ready.** Carry out routine checks and maintenance, organize tools and spares, and follow lab safety procedures.
* **Improve how the lab runs.** Keep operating instructions current, flag recurring problems, and, where your skills allow, contribute fixtures, 3D-printed parts, or scripts.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* A recent graduate or early-career background in robotics, mechatronics, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field, with substantial hands-on hardware experience from labs, projects, internships, or similar practical work. We do not require two years of professional experience for this posting.
* Evidence that you have built, operated, maintained, or troubleshot robots, lab equipment, or electromechanical systems yourself.
* Practical troubleshooting: you can investigate a fault, test likely causes with appropriate tools, and explain what you learned.
* Careful execution of multi-step procedures, with strong attention to detail and reliable records.
* The ability to develop toward independently running a full day of trials after training, resolving routine problems, and recognizing when to ask for help.
* Clear communication and teamwork with researchers and engineers.
* Confidence picking up unfamiliar tools and software workflows.
* 3D printing experience, including through university or personal projects.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* ROS 2, Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, or another simulator you’ve debugged rather than just launched.
* Experience running benchmark or test campaigns where the count and ordering of trials matter.

**Growing With Us**
-------------------

Recent graduates are welcome to apply. We are a small, growing team working on one of the most interesting problems in AI. You do not need to tick every box. If you are curious and keen to learn, we will support you to develop your practical skills and take on more responsibility.

**Why Artificial Analysis?**
----------------------------

* **Shape how AI gets built.** Leading AI labs track our benchmarks and use them to guide their development priorities. Your work will help the industry understand how AI performs in the physical world.
* **Build expertise in frontier AI and robotics.** Work closely with researchers and engineers evaluating AI models on physical robots and in simulation.
* **Join at a defining moment.** We’re 50+ people, on track to double by year end, backed by some of the most connected investors in AI. The people who join now will shape the product, team, and strategy as we scale.
* Competitive compensation.

jobs.title: Soils & Materials Laboratory Technician
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Hushmand Associates, Inc. (HAI), a geotechnical engineering and construction materials testing firm, is seeking experienced **Soils & Materials Laboratory Technicians** for the **Anderson Dam Seismic Retrofit Project in Morgan Hill, California**.

This is a full-time, project-based position supporting a major dam construction project **anticipated to last at least 7 years**, offering an opportunity for long-term employment.

The position primarily involves laboratory testing of soils, aggregates, and other construction materials in accordance with applicable ASTM and AASHTO standards and project specifications.

We are seeking dependable individuals with hands-on laboratory testing experience, strong attention to detail, proficiency in Microsoft Excel, and the ability to perform laboratory tests accurately and efficiently.

**Duties**

* Perform laboratory testing of soils, aggregates, and construction materials in accordance with applicable ASTM and AASHTO standards.
* Conduct Standard and Modified Proctor compaction tests (ASTM D698 and D1557).
* Perform sieve analysis, washed gradation, moisture content, Atterberg limits, specific gravity, and other soil classification tests.
* Conduct aggregate testing, including gradation, specific gravity, absorption, and other applicable tests.
* Perform additional laboratory testing of soils and aggregates as assigned.
* Prepare, process, and handle soil and aggregate samples for laboratory testing.
* Enter laboratory test data, measurements, and calculations accurately into Microsoft Excel spreadsheets.
* Complete laboratory testing worksheets using existing Excel templates and verify data entries for accuracy and completeness.
* Maintain organized laboratory testing records and documentation.
* Operate, maintain, and verify laboratory testing equipment.
* Follow laboratory quality control procedures, safety requirements, and project specifications.
* Communicate testing results, unusual findings, and testing issues promptly to laboratory supervisors.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and safe laboratory work environment.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Previous hands-on experience in geotechnical or construction materials laboratory testing.
* Minimum 3 years of laboratory testing experience preferred.
* Familiarity with ASTM and AASHTO laboratory testing procedures.
* Ability to independently perform common soils and aggregate laboratory tests.
* **Proficiency in Microsoft Excel is required**, including data entry, basic formulas, and working with existing laboratory testing spreadsheets.
* Ability to accurately enter and review laboratory test data without altering existing spreadsheet formulas.
* Ability to perform basic mathematical calculations accurately, including percentages, unit conversions, and laboratory test calculations.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in recording and entering test data.
* Ability to maintain accurate testing records and documentation.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a laboratory team.
* Experience operating laboratory testing equipment and following quality control procedures.
* High school diploma or equivalent.

**Preferred Certifications**

* ACI Aggregate Base Testing Technician
* ACI Aggregate Testing Technician – Level 1
* ACI Aggregate Testing Technician – Level 2
* ACI Concrete Laboratory Testing Technician – Level 1
* Relevant Caltrans laboratory testing certifications

Candidates with substantial hands-on laboratory testing experience are encouraged to apply even if they do not currently hold all listed certifications.

**Additional Information**

* **Job Type:** Full-time, project-based
* **Work Location:** Anderson Dam Seismic Retrofit Project, Morgan Hill, CA 95037
* **Work Setting:** Onsite construction materials testing laboratory
* **Schedule:** Approximately 40 hours per week, with overtime as needed
* **Project Duration:** Anticipated to last at least 7 years
* **Compensation:** Based on experience and qualifications

Employment duration and work schedules are subject to project needs and workload.

Hushmand Associates, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Principal Investigator, David Traver, PhD, is looking for a Research Associate I to join the team!**

Working under direct supervision, the Research Associate I performs a variety of routine experimental protocols and procedures to support the objectives of one or more laboratory research projects in a specific area of research. Assists in general laboratory activities, including maintenance of reagents and stocking of supplies. Files and monitors documents. Keeps accurate and detailed records of experiments and results. jobs.title: Dental Laboratory Assistant / Digital Lab Technician
jobs.description:
**About the Position**

***RENU Prosthodontics*** is a specialty practice focused on restorative, implant, and prosthetic dentistry. Our in-house lab combines traditional craftsmanship with digital scanning, computer-aided design, and 3D printing.

We are looking for a detail-oriented, dependable team member who enjoys hands-on work and technology. **This is a lab-only role,** with no chairside or patient-care duties.

ResponsibilitiesModels & Bench Work

* Pour, trim, base, and mount stone models on articulators; prepare bite registrations and diagnostic models.

* Assist with denture processing (waxing, acrylic, trimming, finishing, polishing), plus repairs and adjustments as skills develop.

Digital & 3D Printing

* Prepare print files and run printers through washing, curing, and finishing.

* Produce models, surgical guides, nightguards, retainers, and dentures, and check them for quality.

* Maintain printing equipment and learn our design and lab software.

Case Management & Inventory

* Review upcoming patient schedules and track each case so it is ready before the appointment.

* Pull and prepare implant components and materials for scheduled procedures.

* Keep the clinical team updated on case status, missing parts, and deadlines.

* Manage lab inventory and keep the workspace clean, organized, and safe.

Safety

* Complete OSHA/Cal-OSHA safety and infection control training, and follow lab protocols for PPE, disinfection, chemicals, and waste.

QualificationsRequired

* Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through.

* Good manual dexterity and comfort learning new software.

* Able to manage time, meet deadlines, and take initiative.

* Reliable, punctual, and a clear communicator.

Preferred

* Dental lab or dental office experience.

* Familiarity with implant components, dental materials, or denture processing.

* Experience with 3D printing, digital dental workflows, or case-tracking software.

*No dental assisting license or prior lab experience required. We provide hands-on training in both traditional and digital techniques.*

Who thrives here

Our ideal teammate:

* Enjoys detailed, hands-on work and working with technology.

* Is naturally organized and takes pride in keeping things running smoothly.

* Takes initiative — spots what needs to be done instead of waiting to be asked.

* Follows through and understands why accuracy and deadlines matter.

* Communicates clearly and enjoys learning new skills.

We value a positive attitude, reliability, and willingness to learn just as much as previous experience.

How to Apply

Send your resume and a short note via Email to lab@renuprosthodontics.com about any relevant experience, such as dental lab work, 3D printing, dental assisting, or other hands-on technical work. Experienced technicians and motivated newcomers are both welcome.

Pay: $22.00 - $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 32.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Laboratory Assistant
jobs.description:
**Job Summary and Responsibilities**

As a Lab Assistant, you will play a crucial role in solving diagnostic mysteries, bringing us one step closer to effectively treating patient illnesses and injuries.

Every day, you will utilize your expertise and our advanced technology to precisely collect, prepare, and process a diverse range of patient specimens (blood, urine, tissue, etc.) for various diagnostic tests.

To be successful in this role, you will possess a foundational understanding of laboratory procedures, demonstrate meticulous attention to detail, and maintain an eager commitment to continuous learning and professional development.

* The lab assistant must be able to demonstrate the knowledge and skills necessary to provide appropriate care relative to the patient's age-specific needs.
* This lab assistant will play a critical role in the Emergency Room schedule
* Assist with specimen processing, including labeling, centrifuging, and aliquoting.
* Prepare reagents and solutions according to established protocols.
* Maintain laboratory equipment and supplies to ensure cleanliness and proper functioning.
* Perform routine lab tasks such as washing glassware, sterilizing instruments, and preparing culture media.
* Assist with data entry and record-keeping, ensuring accuracy and compliance with relevant regulations.
* Assist with other tasks as assigned by the laboratory supervisor.
* Will be required to work in the Emergency Room

 **Job Requirements**

Required:

* High School Diploma or GED
* Lab processing experience from an acute care facility
* California Phlebotomy Technician License
* AHA Basic Life Support Certification
* Fire Safety Card within 90 days of hire.

Where You'll Work

Founded in 1955, Dignity Health - Northridge Hospital Medical Center is a 394-bed, acute care, nonprofit hospital located. Serving over 80,000 patients annually, the hospital offers a full complement of services including a Level II Trauma Center, heart care, cancer care and women’s health. It is the only pediatric trauma center in the San Fernando Valley.

Additionally, Northridge Hospital Medical Center has been recognized as an LGBTQ+ Healthcare Equality High Performer by the Human Rights Campaign Foundation. It is a Joint Commission-certified Thrombectomy-Capable Stroke Center and has been recognized as one of America’s 50 Best Hospitals by Healthgrades in 2026.

One Community. One Mission. One California

jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**

The Lundquist Institute for Biomedical Innovation at Harbor-UCLA Medical Center (TLI) is Los Angeles County's preeminent independent, not-for-profit biomedical research hub, excelling in transforming scientific breakthroughs into practical therapies. With a $90 million annual budget, TLI is home to over 150 investigators and 500 staff, advancing 600 projects in areas such as Infection and Immunity, Cancer, and Women's Health. Founded in 1952, the Institute continues to train physician-scientists and manage healthcare programs for 60,000 underserved families throughout South Los Angeles.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Conduct molecular biology assays and experiments, immunohistochemistry, immunocytochemistry, flow cytometry, histology, mouse experiment.
* Collection and analysis of data for publications and planning future experiments.
* Organized record keeping of data from research.
* Actively participate in successful planning, execution, publication, and presentation of experiments.
* Perform interpretation of experimental results and analysis of data.
* Prepare manuscripts for publication in scientific journals based on experimental results.
* Routine lab maintenance and animal model generation and maintenance.
* Work independently in the design and performance of experiments, making graphs, keeping statistics, and interpretation and dissemination of data.
* Conduct research independently and with a team.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**EDUCATION**

* Master's degree in health science or related major

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Three years lab experience in cell culture and related work
* Experience in RT-PCR, fluorescent microscope
* Experience in Western blot, immunoprecipitation
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

* Health Insurance: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and eligible dependents
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* Life & Disability Insurance
* Voluntary 403(b) Retirement Plan: Immediate eligibility to participate in the tax-deferred retirement savings plan
* 401(a) Retirement Plan
* Vacation: 3 weeks annually
* Sick Leave: 2 weeks annually
* Paid Holidays: 13 paid holidays annually

**Position requires a background check and health clearance**
